rooms.content:
One lesson, one skill 🛡️ By the end you can warn a friend in English and keep your Roblox account safe.

  • Six gamer words: account, password, scam, stranger, link, report
  • The first conditional: If + present, will + verb
  • Three moves: block, report, tell a trusted adult
  • Your own safety pledge — written by you
How this lesson works: every room gives you the words first and the people second. Read every line out loud and swap in your own game name — a word you say about your real account is a word you keep.Đọc to mọi câu và thay tên game của bạn vào — từ nào bạn dùng cho tài khoản thật thì bạn sẽ nhớ.
rooms.label: Warm-Up
rooms.title: The Entrance

rooms.content:
Minh: Tom, look. Free Robux. One thousand. Just type your password here 🙋
Tom: No way. If you type your password there, you will lose your account.
Linh: Minh, who sent the link?
Minh: A stranger. Username xX_free_gems_Xx 😅
Tom: That is a scam. Block him. Report the link. Then tell your brother.
🤔 Reality check: Minh saw free Robux and stopped thinking. Tom saw a stranger plus a password box and knew it was a scam.Minh thấy Robux miễn phí là ngừng suy nghĩ. Tom thấy người lạ cộng ô mật khẩu là biết lừa đảo.
rooms.label: Scene
rooms.title: The Free Robux Trap

rooms.content:
Minh: bro it says FREE robux 💸 just login here
Tom: stop. who sent it 🙄
Minh: idk some stranger. link looks real tho
Linh: if you click that link, you will lose everything 😏
Minh: ok ok. block + report. done ✅
Tom: good. never share passwords. not even with friends 🎮
🤔 Reality check: in chat the scam looks small and friendly — one link, one stranger, one password box. That is always the pattern.Trong chat, lừa đảo trông nhỏ và thân thiện — một link, một người lạ, một ô mật khẩu. Đó luôn là công thức.
Pro Tip: the first conditional warns about the future: If + present, will + verb. If you share your password, you will lose your account. Say it before you click anything.Câu điều kiện loại 1 cảnh báo tương lai: If + hiện tại, will + động từ.
rooms.label: Text Scene
rooms.title: The Group Chat

rooms.content:
1. account: your personal game profile with your name and items — If you share your password, you will lose your account.tài khoản game của bạn
2. password: the secret word that opens your account — Never tell anyone your password.mật khẩu
3. stranger: a person you do not know — Never trust a stranger with your password.người lạ
4. scam: a trick that steals your things or information — Free Robux links are a scam.trò lừa đảo
5. report: tell the game the message is bad, with one tap — Block the stranger and report the link.báo cáo, tố cáo
Build a warning in one line: If you click a strange link, you will lose your account. If + present, will + verb. That is the whole grammar, and it protects you.If + hiện tại, will + động từ. Đó là toàn bộ ngữ pháp, và nó bảo vệ bạn.
rooms.label: Learn
rooms.title: The Words

rooms.content:
How to win: the hint under each row is the meaning — read it, then click the letter tiles in order. A wrong word shakes and clears itself, so nothing is lost.

Retrieval speed: say each word out loud as you build it — password, scam, stranger, report. Loud and wrong beats silent and correct.
rooms.label: Game 1
rooms.title: Game 1 — Password Scramble

rooms.content:
Scenario: A player named xX_free_gems_Xx sends Minh a link and asks for his password. What should Minh do?
Scenario: Warn Linh about the strange link. Which sentence is correct English?
Scenario: Tom blocked the stranger. What is the next move that protects other players too?
rooms.label: Test
rooms.title: The Test

rooms.content:
How to win: click a word on the left, then its meaning on the right. Six pairs. Wrong pairs shake and let go — guess boldly.

Paired recall: each word sticks to one real memory — password to the login box, scam to the free-Robux lie, stranger to the unknown username.
rooms.label: Game 2
rooms.title: Game 2 — Safe or Scam

rooms.content:
How to win: click an action, then the group it belongs to. Say each one out loud as one warning — it should sound like a rule, not a suggestion.

The three groups: SAFE keeps your account yours · RISKY hands it to a stranger · REPORT stops the scammer for everyone.
rooms.label: Game 3
rooms.title: Game 3 — Safe, Risky, Report

rooms.content:
🎓 You now hold the key
  • Six words: account, password, stranger, scam, link, report.
  • One rule: If + present, will + verb — If you click it, you will lose it.
  • Three moves: block the stranger, report the link, tell a trusted adult.
  • One reflex: a stranger plus a password box is always a scam.
  • Say it loud: loud and wrong beats silent and correct — but safe beats sorry.
Level Up: tonight, teach one person outside this class the warning sentence: If you share your password, you will lose your account. If they repeat it back, your key works.
Write your pledge (homework): write three first-conditional safety rules of your own — one about passwords, one about links, one about strangers.
